known_limitations.detail: DetectionService intentionally supports only the selected six-class model; the generic 17-class alternative requires a separate explicit mapping.
The 17-class alternative required a 0.05 diagnostic threshold and produced two detections on one of three NEU-DET probe images; the stronger six-class model is selected.
Runtime evidence is authoritatively bound by executed source-file hashes; sourceCommit convenience pointers will be rebased in the final evidence commit.
The source-balanced demo run records predictions, including false positives, but does not compute or claim benchmark accuracy; accurate boxes/types/confidence remains PARTIAL.
Detection, persistence, contract, and API tests plus evidence freshness, import boundaries, frontend utilities, and builds exist; React component and browser end-to-end automation remain planned.
